node.title: KoalaBear c2 (1,1,2) aligned positive unramified moving-swap q-slice exclusion
node.closure: the aligned positive unramified moving-moving swapped-allocation q-slice cell is empty
node.statement: Normalize J_0={2,1/2,b,1/b}, q(T)=T^2+tT+p, and trace=b+b^-1 in the aligned positive unramified moving-moving swapped allocation. Exact scale retention and reciprocal trace descent make the four q-slice equations quadratic in trace. Their coefficient-minor projections have only the forbidden linear component 4p+5t+4, the component pt+5p+t, and finite off-common intersections. The linear component is boundary-supported. The second component generically misses the kernel conic; all six exceptional norm factors are replayed over their finite extensions, with four boundary factors and two candidates failing the original equations. The off-common norm has seven factors and eight endpoint candidates, all on the explicit base forbidden product. Hence this cell is empty; the other five aligned-positive unramified cells remain open.
